name: Cuyahoga Community College
academic_ranking: Cuyahoga Community College (Tri-C) is Ohio's oldest and largest public community college, founded in 1963, serving the Greater Cleveland area across multiple campuses (Metropolitan, Eastern, Western, Westshore). It is an open-admission, two-year institution granting associate degrees and certificates, with transfer pathways to Ohio four-year universities.
financial_aid: As a public community college, Tri-C offers federal and state financial aid (FAFSA-based Pell grants, Ohio College Opportunity Grant), institutional scholarships, and the tuition-free Tri-C High School Scholars/Degree in 3 style programs. NJCAA Division II athletics does not permit athletic scholarships that cover more than tuition, fees, room, board, and books; JUCO programs typically rely on need- and merit-based aid. Specific softball athletic aid not publicly detailed on the athletics site.
facilities_notes: Softball is played under NJCAA Division II / Region 12 within the OCCAC. Specific home softball field/facility details were not published on the softball program pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NJCAA Division II women's softball program competing in the Ohio Community College Athletic Conference (OCCAC) and NJCAA Region 12. Head coach Bryan Komlos leads the program. Detailed competitive/postseason reputation not published on the athletics site as of 2026-07.
notes: Data sourced live 2026-07 from athletics.tri-c.edu softball coaches page (https://athletics.tri-c.edu/sports/sball/coaches/index) and 2025-26 roster (https://athletics.tri-c.edu/sports/sball/2025-26/roster). Roster size = 18 based on 18 unique jersey numbers on 2025-26 roster. Conference (OCCAC) and NJCAA Region 12 affiliation confirmed via athletics site footer logos. Tuition ~$3,349/yr is an estimate for in-county (Cuyahoga County) residents based on Tri-C published Summer/Fall 2026 in-county rate of $139.54/credit hour x 24 credits (two 12-credit semesters); Ohio out-of-county ~$4,058, out-of-state ~$7,349. No public Twitter/X handles listed for any softball staff. Coaches share department phone 216-987-4333 x1464.
